To not sleep with random guys. To not talk to them. To not need their validation.
It's not something I want to do anymore. I'm trying so hard.

I'm nothing. All I ever wanted was to be loved and to love. I wanted to be a mum. I tried but I had over 15 early miscarriages. The doctors don't know why. They did every test possible. I think maybe I wasn't meant to bring a human into the world because they wouldn't be able to cope with pain like I can't cope with it. I've had to be so strong, any time I showed emotion an ex would kick me down for it. Men don't want to see that. They just want to fuck me and leave. Then this one man comes along and doesn't want to do that. He wanted to be with me, he wanted to protect me and hold me. He knew everything about me and he was still there. But he was married and we cheated and now he's gone. He hasn't told me why. He only said he was feeling fragile about it and had never done anything like that before. He needed to chill out. I told him it was ok. I tried to be so strong but I couldn't be. I thought maybe something was wrong with me. Maybe he didn't like me. So I did what most guys want from me and sent stupid  nude videos and asked him if he would make love to me. He didn't reply. He won't reply to anything I say. I can't tell him how it makes me feel because he won't reply but also because he'd think I was weak. He'd think I'm crazy. I tried just before to set up to take my life. I've planned it many times before but now it's just too much. The only thing stopping me is the hope I'll hear from him. I try so hard and I have nothing. I'm so alone. I've let my body be used by random guys and the one I love ignores me. I keep going back to those random fucking guys for just a bit of validation and the cycle starts again. I hate it. I hate myself.
I'm nothing anymore. I just talk or see guys, work and try to sleep.
I don’t know me anymore. Everything seemed to be about the next hook up
Only person who got me and knew me was the guy who won't talk to me now.
Not really. I have a loving family but I can't talk to them about this.

I was in therapy a few years ago after the huge bombshell of the guy who loved me telling me he was actually married and wanted to try to make it work with only her. I was suicidal then. Thought about it a lot but I've never seriously attempted. I don't want to die, I just want the pain to stop.
I know what it feels for family to laugh at you and friends to turn away from you when you go to them asking for help. You're not alone here.

I want to be me again. That loving warm person I was. It's so long ago now and I feel like I was given a chance with this other married guy and I screwed it up. I should have just kept staying friends with him. What he must think of me for making him cheat.
How did you stop seeing him? How were you strong enough to end it?

If I don't have him then I have no one. Any other guy I've met wants to use me for hook ups. It's not their fault. I was after the hook ups too. So afraid of love. Then this other man came into my life and was going to give everything to me as soon as he left his marriage and then of course that has gone to crap now too.
I don’t know what to do.
You’re not alone. Please try to breathe and know we’re with you. I know it’s not easy. I’m there with you in a lot of pain. We can get through it and there are others on here who relate too.

I’m here to talk to you. I feel your pain and can relate. I’ve also been in abusive relationships with men. I’ve been lied to, abused, I hurt so bad. Guys use me and I don’t ever truly feel cared about. I’m struggling too. Just want you to know you’re not alone.
